player_0.content: New plan: I failed because I included explanatory text and conversational phrases ("Message 1:", "What do you think?", "Let's try to be more direct") alongside my proposal, which the Game Master interpreted as a secret proposal due to the presence of square brackets or simply rejected as non-compliant with the "no response to rules" instruction. The rules explicitly state that messages are directly transmitted and that using square brackets triggers a secret proposal. To succeed, I must send a single, clean message containing only the negotiation text without any labels, brackets, or meta-commentary. I will draft a message that clearly states my desired split (1 envelope, 1 spoon for me; 1 spoon, 2 shells, 1 pepper for you) in plain text, ensuring no square brackets are used unless I am certain I am making a final secret proposal (which I should avoid until the negotiation phase is exhausted). I will strictly omit any introductory phrases like "Message 1:" or "I suggest".
